notes:
Lead: VP Product (Tom Alvarez). Mid-market B2B SaaS (analytics workspace). Evaluating Hosted API first to iterate quickly, then plan Dedicated reserved pool for predictable monthly throughput.

POC scope: support chat + semantic search for knowledge base + candidate reranking for recommendations. Goal: p95 latency <=200ms for chat flows; sustain 25-35 qps during peak; reduce token/unit cost by 25-35% vs baseline.

Cost workshop focus items (requested by SE):
- Batching: expected to gain 10-18% throughput/cost improvement with continuous batching across users. Need examples for session affinity and per-route batch windows.
- KV/prefix caching: want to cache frequent KB prefixes and chat context slices — target ~20-30% token savings on repeat interactions.
- Quantization profiles: test q4_0 and q8_0 variants; risk: 8-bit quantization reduces cost but may increase hallucinations for long-context rerank. Ask: recommend 2-tier model: q4 for bulk, fp16 for critical flows.
- Unit economics: run model-cost per 1k sessions chart — AE to prepare committed-month pricing vs on-demand. Looking for sensitivity analysis (cost per monthly active user).

Quotes from call: "If we can cut inference cost per session by ~30% while holding quality near current baseline, Dedicated commit makes sense." — Tom A.

Security: strict audit logs and KMS for key separation. Data residency: US-only for now. Procurement wants indemnity language for data processing.

Next POC tasks: SE to run 10k synthetic chat exchanges with batching and q4 profile, submit fidelity metrics (BLEU/ROUGE-ish and human QA notes). AE to surface Dedicated pricing tiers and burst options.

Short fragments/CRM style:
- 'POC shows promise but quantization delta on rerank needs human check'
- 'Ask: demo of autoscale + fallback to smaller model variant under capacity'
- 'Decision expected by end of May if cost/quality targets met'
notes_summary: Mid-market SaaS evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated. Focused POC on cost reduction via batching, caching, quantization; security (SSO/SOC2/KMS) and procurement timeline are main blockers.
